A digital product designer is someone who is responsible for designing and creating digital products such as websites, mobile apps, software, and other digital interfaces.
Their main goal is to create an intuitive and user-friendly digital product that meets the needs of the target audience while also meeting business goals and objectives.
Digital product designers typically work in a cross-functional team that includes product managers, developers, and other stakeholders.
They are involved in the entire product development process, from researching user needs to designing user interfaces, to testing and refining the product.
The role of a digital product designer requires a strong understanding of user experience (UX) design, user interface (UI) design, visual design, and human-computer interaction.
